description: This file contains source code implementing a menu-based configuration interface, including functions for managing menus, symbols, properties, dependencies, and expressions in a configuration system, likely for a kernel or embedded system build configuration.

methods.name: void menu_warn(struct menu * menu,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Logs a warning message associated with a menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_entry(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Adds a new menu entry with a symbol at the current position.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_add_menu(void)
methods.description: Creates a new submenu, updating the current menu context.

methods.name: void menu_end_menu(void)
methods.description: Ends the current menu context, returning to parent menu.

methods.name: void menu_add_dep(struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a dependency expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_set_type(int type)
methods.description: Sets the type of the current menu's symbol, warning if redefinition.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prop(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a property (e.g., default, prompt) to the current menu entry.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prompt(enum prop_type type,char * prompt,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a prompt property to the current menu entry with handling for whitespace and visibility.

methods.name: void menu_add_visibility(struct expr * expr)
methods.description: Adds a visibility expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_expr(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds an expression property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_symbol(enum prop_type type,struct symbol * sym,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Associates a symbol with the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_finalize(struct menu * parent)
methods.description: Recursively finalizes menu hierarchy, handling dependencies, choices, and automatic submenus.

methods.name: bool menu_has_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Checks if the menu has a prompt.

methods.name: bool menu_is_empty(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Determines if a menu contains no or only invisible entries.

methods.name: bool menu_is_visible(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Evaluates if a menu is visible based on its prompts, dependencies, and symbol states.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Retrieves the prompt string of a menu.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_get_parent_menu(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the parent menu of a given menu, searching upward until a menu with P_MENU type.

methods.name: bool menu_has_help(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Checks if a menu has help text.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_help(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Retrieves the help string associated with a menu.

methods.name: void menu_get_ext_help(struct menu * menu,struct gstr * help)
methods.description: Generates a detailed string describing the menu, its prompt, dependencies, location, and related info.

methods.name: struct:gstr get_relations_str(struct symbol ** sym_arr,struct list_head * head)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a string describing relations of a list of symbols.

methods.name: void _menu_init(void)
methods.description: unavailable
